name: Doctor On Demand
one_liner: Video visits with therapists, psychiatrists and doctors through Included Health's Doctor On Demand app, with insurance or per-visit self-pay.
best_for: Adults with mild to moderate anxiety or depression who want video therapy or psychiatry
People whose health plan or employer covers Doctor On Demand (often $0)
People who want to pay per visit with no membership
People who want mental health and medical visits in one app
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who need controlled substances such as ADHD stimulants or benzodiazepines
People with severe or complex conditions needing intensive or in-person care
People who want unlimited messaging with a therapist between sessions
short_description: A US telehealth service, now part of Included Health, offering video therapy, psychiatry, urgent care and primary care, billed to insurance or paid per visit.
long_description: Doctor On Demand is a US telehealth service that merged with Grand Rounds in 2021 to form Included Health, which now runs it as Doctor On Demand by Included Health. Alongside urgent and primary care, it offers mental health care. You create a free account, then book a video visit with a licensed psychologist or therapist (from $134 for 25 minutes self-pay) or a psychiatrist ($299 for a 45-minute first visit, then $129 for 15-minute follow-ups); with insurance or employer coverage the cost is often $0. Mental health visits are by appointment and usually available within 1 to 2 days. The service is aimed at mild to moderate symptoms, and its clinicians do not prescribe controlled substances. No published study of Doctor On Demand's mental health service was found.
patient_summary: You sign up free at Doctor On Demand, now run by Included Health, and book a video visit with a therapist, psychiatrist or medical doctor. With insurance or employer coverage visits are often $0; self-pay therapy starts at $134 and a first psychiatry visit is $299.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance (often $0); $134/session therapy or $299 first psychiatry visit self-pay
pricing.notes: Self-pay: therapy from $134 for 25 minutes; psychiatry $299 for a 45-minute first visit, then $129 for a 15-minute follow-up. Free account, no membership fee, no card needed to sign up; your exact price is shown before booking. Many health plans and employers cover visits.

privacy.notes: Included Health says it does not sell personal information, but its third-party cookies and analytics may count as a sale or share under state law (a Do Not Sell or Share link is offered); visit records fall under its HIPAA notice.

seo.title: Doctor On Demand: 24/7 Telehealth Psychiatry & Therapy
seo.meta_description: Doctor on Demand provides video psychiatry and therapy appointments, typically covered by insurance with $0-75 copays and same-day availability.

faqs.q: How much does Doctor on Demand psychiatry cost?
faqs.a: With insurance, expect $0-75 copay for psychiatry visits. Self-pay is $299 for psychiatry and $129-179 for therapy. Many employers include Doctor on Demand in health benefits at no cost. Check your insurance portal for telehealth mental health coverage.

faqs.q: Can Doctor on Demand prescribe anxiety medication?
faqs.a: Yes, Doctor on Demand psychiatrists can prescribe anxiety medications including SSRIs, SNRIs, buspirone, and in some cases controlled substances. Prescribing follows state regulations and DEA telehealth guidelines. Initial evaluation required.

faqs.q: How quickly can I see a Doctor on Demand psychiatrist?
faqs.a: Many psychiatry appointments are available same-day or within 24-48 hours—much faster than traditional psychiatry wait times of 4-12 weeks. Therapy appointments also have quick availability. Check the app for current openings.

faqs.q: Is Doctor on Demand part of Included Health?
faqs.a: Yes, Doctor on Demand merged with Grand Rounds in 2022 to form Included Health. Services continue under the Doctor on Demand brand for telehealth. Included Health offers additional healthcare navigation services through employers.

primary_uses: Video therapy with a licensed psychologist or therapist
Psychiatric evaluation and medication management by video
Treatment of mild to moderate depression and anxiety
Urgent and primary care visits in the same app

availability.note: Run by Included Health; anyone can sign up free at doctorondemand.com or in the app, with or without insurance. Mental health visits are by appointment, usually within 1 to 2 days. No controlled substances.
